defects: CODE: lines 541-543 infer pair groups solely from an all-1-then-all-0 label layout even when the caller supplied no groups. On the same finite representations this emitted 0.9166667 instead of StratifiedKFold's 0.3333333; driving the repository's own ordered parity fixture through evaluate() emitted 0.9966667 rather than its stored stratified reference 0.9833333.

For each layer, either mark the whole layer NaN when any row is non-finite, matching the paper's layer-exclusion wording, or mask X, y, and groups together, recompute class counts/n_splits, and fail closed if any train/test fold lacks both classes. Validate labels without lossy int() coercion. Separately, align the effective 20-pair protocol with the 39-pair bundle, emit a permutation/bootstrap interval, and standardize features or otherwise specify a scale-invariant probe policy before cross-model use.
